text:
eva_marketing: quick heads-up  inbound HubSpot leads are stalling in enrichment and not creating Salesforce records within SLA (~5-10m). SDRs are noticing. :frowning:

nate_ops: saw the spike on the dashboard around 11:30 PST. rr-claim slots look busy; enrichment p99 jumped and retries piled up. claims return but SF create is delayed. :eyes:

mo_salesops: our SLA: ack <30s, assigned <2m, SF create <5m. current >5m rate is ~12% for the last 30m.

riley_eng: pipeline is hs webhook -> enrichment (async) -> rr-claim -> sf-create. when enrichment backlog grows rr-claim holds items waiting for enriched payloads. quick mitigation: enable TTL fallback that bypasses enrichment after 75s and sends a minimal payload to SF with property `enrich_skipped=true` and tag `ttl75_peak_canary`. also bump enrichment workers for the window.

eva_marketing: can we gate to peak window only and tag events so SDRs can filter? worried about noise in SF.

nate_ops: yes. propose 30m canary during the peak. ops will add dashboard tile for `enrich_skipped` and an alert for `enrichment.queue > 500`.

riley_eng: config i can flip quickly:
```yaml
enrichment:
  workers: 36
  timeout_seconds: 75
  fallback_to_minimal_sf_payload: true
  fallback_tag: "ttl75_peak_canary"
rr_claim:
  fairness_window_ms: 4500
```

mo_salesops: please add a dashboard filter and notify SDR leads that some records may show `enrich_skipped=true`. we'll treat those as low-confidence handoffs.

deploy-bot: deploy started by nate_ops at 5112223410 :rocket:

riley_eng: deployed and enabled fallback. warming workers.

eva_marketing: monitoring  early signal: >5m assigns dropped from 12% -> 3% in first 4m. good initial result. :tada:

mo_salesops: next steps: riley to open RFC for RR fairness + TTL-based graceful degrade, nate to create alert `enrichment.backlog.count > 500 for 5m` and a dashboard for `ttl75_peak_canary`, eva to draft the SDR comms.

riley_eng: RFC will include test matrix and perf numbers.

nate_ops: alert and dashboard tile created. will page on-call if threshold persists.

eva_marketing: thanks team. follow-up in marketing-ops tomorrow.
